{{Quote|What in the name of my Aunt Sadie's armored underdrawers are you misbegotten idiots doing blocking my ships?|Captain Meeba, to Thaereian military customs ships blocking the path of Strike Force Cularin|<ref name="DA" />}}
'''Sadie''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who was the aunt of [[Meeba (Republic Navy)|Meeba]], a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Relentless (cruiser)|''Relentless'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="DA" /> Sadie was known to wear [[Clothing/Legends|undergarments]] and around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Decision: Almas]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Meeba mentioned his Aunt Sadie's underwear while berating [[Thaereian military]] customs [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that were blocking the path of the Republic [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] [[Strike Force Cularin]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="DA" />
